scientific_limits: This method was selected after BY; deterministic cases and backgrounds were already exposed.
Recovery monotonicity is guaranteed by retaining exact old seed rows, not independent scientific evidence.
Added correlated templates increase trial opportunities; ESS thresholds are not recalibrated to a common global false-alarm probability.
Only truth-local drift intervals and normalized injected amplitudes are tested; no Jy sensitivity, blind all-bank recovery, or normalization-response result.
Both retained and rejected flags can be true through distinct overlapping seeds; they are not exclusive case categories.
No new raw observations, completed cadence, extraterrestrial candidate or source-coverage advance follows from this experiment.
